name: Mushoku Ningen Ikusei Shuukan
source:
You saved a man who has no job or house, and decided to let him live in your house for time being. 
Support him in his job search, or just have fun together for a week... 
His future depends on your choice!
translation:
你救了一个没有工作、没有房子的男人，并决定让他暂时住在你家里。
支持他找工作，或者只是一起玩一周…… 
他的未来取决于你的选择！
